mapper.update: UPDATE model_assets SET name = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.name}, ''), name), description = #{request.description}, tags_json = COALESCE(#{request.tags,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, tags_json), category = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.category}, ''), category), element_type_id = NULLIF(#{request.elementTypeId}, ''), license = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.license}, ''), license), has_animations = COALESCE(#{request.hasAnimations}, has_animations), has_textures = COALESCE(#{request.hasTextures}, has_textures), custom_props_json = #{request.customPropsJson}, position_json = COALESCE(#{request.position,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.Vector3JsonTypeHandler}, position_json), rotation_json = COALESCE(#{request.rotation,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.Vector3JsonTypeHandler}, rotation_json), scale_json = COALESCE(#{request.scale,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.Vector3JsonTypeHandler}, scale_json) WHERE id = #{id}
